answer: Producing 90 answers an epoch as a result costs 16 real forward passes, and the inlet record lets any auditor recompute the check. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a knoll spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a fable header. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
